---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect or unexpected OLLITERATOR behavior
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

## Summary

Describe the observed behavior.

## Expected behavior

Describe what you expected OLLITERATOR to do.

## Version or commit

Provide the OLLITERATOR version, commit, or artifact identifier.

## Hardware

Provide relevant hardware details without publishing serial numbers, UUIDs,
WWNs, MAC addresses, credentials, or other unnecessary identifiers.

## Reproduction

Provide the minimum steps required to reproduce the issue.

## Observed output

Include relevant logs or refusal messages after removing private or identifying
information.

## Safety impact

Could this issue affect:

- target authorization;
- candidate counting;
- removable-device exclusion;
- USB-topology exclusion;
- destructive containment;
- wipe verification;
- installer handoff; or
- hardware prosecution claims?

If yes, explain briefly.

## Destructive testing

Do not perform a new destructive test merely to complete this issue.

If the report describes a potential authorization or containment bypass, follow
`SECURITY.md` instead of publishing exploit details here.
